name: consentgrid
description: DPDP Consent Artifact Platform — tamper-evident, multilingual, purpose-bound consent capture for India's DPDP Act 2023 / Rules 2025.

config.note: DATABASE_URL selects the backend. sqlite://<path> or :memory: uses the built-in node:sqlite adapter (zero deps, used for local dev + CI tests). postgres://... uses the pg adapter (production; requires `npm i pg` where the registry is reachable).
